synopsis_paragraphs: Spoiler-light premise only. The public pitch is a floor: Nao Kanzaki is honest to a fault. Uncorrupted and virtuous, Nao is the perfect target for a large-scale scheme—the so-called Liar Game. Suddenly in possession of one hundred million yen, she is expected to steal the same amount from her assigned opponent—her former middle school teacher—or face crushing debt.

Trusting her teacher without question, Nao quickly realizes that she is trapped.
